title: DescribeResponse
description: What the source is and which selector fields it applies itself.

source.description: The source's name, the prefix of every item id it returns.

nativeFields.description: The selector fields the source applies when it fetches; the store's matcher applies every field again after the fetch.

pageCostUsd.description: The most one fetch can cost in US dollars, so a sync can stop before a page would pass a monthly cap; left out when the source cannot say.
